speaker: dvm
text: Hello, it's Doctor Haddad. Your sitter brought Clover in, and I'd like to ask you a few questions while I look at her. You're on speaker.

speaker: client
text: Thank you. I'm away for work until Friday. The sitter said she hasn't eaten since yesterday morning.

speaker: dvm
text: When did she last pass droppings, do you know?

speaker: client
text: The sitter said there were only a few tiny dry ones last night, and none this morning.

speaker: dvm
text: What does she normally eat?

speaker: client
text: Unlimited timothy hay, a quarter cup of pellets, and fresh greens in the evening, mostly romaine and cilantro.

speaker: dvm
text: Has anything changed recently? Diet, stress, new animals?

speaker: client
text: We moved apartments two weeks ago. And the sitter is new, so maybe that's stressful for her.

speaker: dvm
text: Has she had any problems like this before?

speaker: client
text: Once, last spring. She was in for gut stasis, and she got better with fluids and the syringe feeding.

speaker: dvm
text: Is she on any medication at the moment?

speaker: client
text: No medications. She was spayed when she was six months old. She's four years old now.

speaker: dvm
text: Okay. She weighs one point nine kilos. Her temperature is thirty eight point one, which is normal for a rabbit. Heart rate is two hundred and twenty.

speaker: dvm
text: Her gut sounds are reduced on both sides. Her belly is soft, with no gas I can feel and no mass. Her incisors look good and are not overgrown.

speaker: dvm
text: With the scope, I can see small sharp points on her lower back teeth, on the left side. That could make chewing hay sore.

speaker: client
text: Oh, I didn't know that was possible. Would that be why she stopped eating?

speaker: dvm
text: It could be part of it, along with the stress of the move. Right now this looks like early gut stasis.

speaker: dvm
text: I'd like to give fluids under the skin today, start syringe feeding with a critical care formula, and give meloxicam for pain.

speaker: dvm
text: I'd also like to trim those tooth points under a short sedation, maybe tomorrow if she's eating a bit.

speaker: client
text: Yes to all of it. Can she stay with you overnight? The sitter isn't comfortable syringe feeding.

speaker: dvm
text: Yes, we'll keep her in the hospital tonight and update you tomorrow morning.

speaker: client
text: Please call me before nine, I have meetings after that. And she hates being picked up, so be gentle with her back legs.

speaker: dvm
text: We will. I'll call you before nine tomorrow.
